statement: Korean buildout commitments name SK Group taking 2 gigawatts of Nvidia Rubin systems and Naver a 200-megawatt order, because Korea lacks a domestic cutting-edge accelerator supplier.
why: Gigawatt-scale Rubin commitments are merchant-GPU design wins captured by default in the absence of a local accelerator alternative.

impact.mechanism: With no domestic accelerator able to serve the programme, sovereign compute spending routes to merchant GPUs rather than local silicon.

evidence.excerpt: currently lacks domestic suppliers capable of independently producing cutting-edge AI accelerators

confidence.basis: Secondary summary of a newsletter; commitment sizes are reported, not confirmed by the buyers' own filings.
